question: What rules and numbers do the boat graphs and the stationary weapon graphs (Phalanx, missile battery) hold?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/vehicles-boat-stationary.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Boats: while `Affector_Vehicles_MobilityDamage` is active, throttle to thrust is 0 (CB90 0x428c, jet ski 0x1d54; RHIB imports the same effect).

CB90 and RHIB boost (0x4694 to 0x5348): meter 0..1; needs sprint input, a driver, throttle above 0, brake 0 and no crawl mode; starts only above the configured threshold x 1.1; drain and recharge are scaled by the consumption and recovery effects; rates come from a vehicle configuration table.
CB90 capsize (inferred): thrust cut at 80 degrees tilt or more; self-righting torque 18 between 80 and 181 degrees when speed is under 5 with a driver seated.
Throttle response time: CB90 0.1 s; RHIB 0.375 / 0.4 s; jet ski 0.7 / 0.85 s.

Phalanx: slew limited to frame time x `PhalanxAimRotationSpeed`; pitch 0 to 90; aim point = position + velocity x T + 0.5 x acceleration x T^2 with T from a distance curve; a sweep offset decays toward `AimStrafeMinimum` over `AimEscalationTime`, 4 x faster against fast targets; bursts alternate `BurstDuration` and `BurstCooldown`; a target is dropped after burst duration + curve x 1.35.

Missile battery: launch speed = sqrt(9.8 x r^2 / (r - dz)), a 45 degree lob; reload from `CS_fSSMBattery_ReloadTime`; six tubes cycle; fires only once the turret has stopped; an owner change resets the reload timer.

inference: The capsize reading rests on the role of the tilt angle temporaries.
unresolved: The unoccupied-boat rule is lost where two branches share a target.
Boost rates and the Phalanx and battery tunables are stored elsewhere.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Boat and stationary weapon graphs read: mobility damage forces boat throttle to 0, boat boost starts above the configured threshold x 1.1, the Phalanx aims with lead compensation and alternating burst and cooldown tunables, and the missile battery launches at the 45 degree lob speed sqrt(9.8 r^2 / (r - dz))
leads.summary: The CB90, jet ski, Phalanx and small stationary graphs were read in full and the RHIB compared by imports. They are locomotion and aiming simulations with no health, repair, ammunition or overheat logic. Mobility damage forces boat throttle to 0; boat boost needs sprint input, a driver, throttle and no brake, and starts above threshold x 1.1; the Phalanx leads its target and fires in bursts; the missile battery lobs at 45 degrees. 11 raw-offset checks matched.
